patterns.message: ENG-31: the core knows no game (ADR 004 item 2). @grimoire/schema and @grimoire/engine never import a system module (@grimoire/system-<id>, in packages/system-<id>/), by name or by a relative path. The module imports the core, never the other way.

ENG-01: the engine is pure TypeScript. It imports only its own files and @grimoire/schema: no React, DOM, Dexie or network library, and no path into apps/ or node_modules/. A new pure dependency is added to this list in biome.json.

ENG-31: the core knows no game (ADR 004 item 2). @grimoire/schema and @grimoire/engine never import a system module (@grimoire/system-<id>, in packages/system-<id>/), by name or by a relative path. The module imports the core, never the other way.

ENG-41: a system module is pure TypeScript, as the engine is (ENG-01, ADR 004 item 1). It imports only its own files, @grimoire/schema, @grimoire/engine and zod: no React, DOM, Dexie or network library, no other package, and no path into apps/ or node_modules/. A new pure dependency is added to this list in biome.json.
